notes: Spiral flute tap for blind holes
Use thread insert for load-bearing threads
Light radial engagement (10% D) high axial
Prefer width > tool D (avoid full slotting)
High speed; wiper inserts for finish
Dry or air blast; 140 deg carbide drill; short chips
Dry; climb milling; dust extraction for grey iron
Face mill with positive inserts; enter off-centre
Light ap; ceramic inserts for roughing
Drill before hardening where possible; otherwise carbide drill for hard materials
